newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Lime completes sale of unit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Lime completes sale of unit.

text.p: United States Lime & Minerals Inc said Monday it completed the sale of assets of its unit, Corson Lime Co, to Highway Materials Inc on June 21.

"With the sale of the primary Corson assets to Highway Materials and our realization on other assets that were not sold to Highway Materials, we expect to generate cash of approximately $9.0 million," said Robert Kizer, president and chief executive officer of U.S. Lime.
The company will now focus on plans to modernize and expand its Texas and Arkansas facilities while also pursuing other growth opportunities, he added.
Corson, located in Plymouth Meeting, Pa., operates a limestone quarry and a lime plant. Highway Materials is a construction company based in Blue Bell, Pa.
